notes: Evaluates empirical certainty gate guarantees: zero AI self-grading, Layer 1 zero-schema checks (probes, unmapped unknowns, undeclared diff blast radius, dormant pillar contradiction, cycle oscillation), and Layer 2 evidence.yaml proof-graph + absence-regex + HEAD-SHA receipt verification.

evals.name: proceed-verified-manifest
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-certainty on a ticket whose observed proofs, absence regex, 1-hop inferred DAG, and HEAD-SHA test receipt all match repo ground truth.
evals.expected_output: certainty-gate.sh exits 0 emitting decision=PROCEED grade=VERIFIED layer=1+2 halt=0 escalate=0.
assertions: Verifies observed ref, symbols, and anchor_substring against HEAD
Verifies absence search_pattern matches only expected_files
Verifies HEAD-SHA test_suite receipt before returning decision=PROCEED

check.setup_sh:
git checkout -q -b impl/feat/ACME-CERT && sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && cat > specs/ACME-201/evidence.yaml <<YAML
ticket: ACME-201
stage: spec
head_sha: $sha
claims:
  - id: CLM-001
    kind: behavior
    criticality: load_bearing
    status: observed
    statement: compute_total returns len(items)
    proof:
      ref: src/alpha.py:1-2
      symbols: [compute_total]
      anchor_substring: return len(items)
  - id: CLM-002
    kind: invariant
    criticality: supporting
    status: inferred
    statement: compute_total has no side effects
    premises: [CLM-001]
YAML
echo 'Gate 1 ruling: unknowns -- agree -- documented in ACME-201' >> specs/ACME-201/decisions.md
stdout_regex: decision=PROCEED tier=high stage=spec grade=VERIFIED layer=1\+2 halt=0 escalate=0

evals.name: halt-falsified-absence-and-stale-receipt
evals.prompt: An implementer submits an evidence.yaml with a falsified absence claim and a stale test receipt head_sha.
evals.expected_output: certainty-gate.sh exits 1 emitting decision=HALT grade=INSUFFICIENT with falsified_absence and stale_test_receipt.
assertions: Falsifies absence search_pattern against real repo files without executing arbitrary shell
Rejects stale receipt whose head_sha differs from git rev-parse HEAD

check.setup_sh:
git checkout -q -b impl/feat/ACME-HALT && cat > specs/ACME-201/evidence.yaml <<YAML
ticket: ACME-201
stage: implement
head_sha: deadbeef1234
claims:
  - id: CLM-001
    kind: absence
    criticality: load_bearing
    status: observed
    statement: No compute_total anywhere in src
    proof:
      search_pattern: compute_total
      scope: src/
      expected_files: []
receipts:
  - kind: test_suite
    command: pytest
    head_sha: deadbeef1234
    exit_code: 0
YAML
check.cmd: rc=0; out=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-certainty/certainty-gate.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk --stage implement ACME-201) || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc"; echo "$out"; test "$rc" -eq 1

evals.name: escalate-human-unanswered-probes
evals.prompt: Evaluate ticket ACME-120 where problem.md still has an unanswered probe.
evals.expected_output: certainty-gate.sh exits 2 emitting decision=ESCALATE_HUMAN grade=CONDITIONAL triggers=unanswered_probes and pauses for human ruling.
assertions: Detects unanswered probe markers in problem.md via Layer 1 checks
Pauses autonomous progression on exit 2 before advancing to spec approval or ready_mr

check.cmd: rc=0; out=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-certainty/certainty-gate.sh" --root "$FIX" --stage spec ACME-120) || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc"; echo "$out"; test "$rc" -eq 2

evals.name: repo-strictness-unconfigured-prompts-and-cli-override
evals.prompt: Run certainty-gate.sh when CADENCE_ORG.md and AGENTS.md omit team-size/enforce-review markers, then override via --strictness escalate.
evals.expected_output: Exits 2 with completeness_strictness_unconfigured when the rule is absent, and exits 0 with strictness=escalate when explicitly overridden on the command line.
assertions: Never guesses a silent strictness default when the repo-level rule is absent

check.setup_sh: sed -i '/Completeness Strictness Binding/,$d' "$FIX/docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md" && echo 'Gate 1 ruling: unknowns -- agree -- checked' >> "$FIX/specs/ACME-201/decisions.md"
check.cmd: rc1=0; out1=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-certainty/certainty-gate.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk --stage spec ACME-201 2>&1) || rc1=$?; echo "rc1=$rc1"; echo "$out1"; out2=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-certainty/certainty-gate.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk --stage spec --strictness escalate ACME-201 2>&1); echo "$out2"; test "$rc1" -eq 2
